body_markdown:
ATLANTA


, Nov. 4, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Invesco Ltd. (NYSE:IVZ ), a leading global asset management firm, announced today that Chief Financial Officer Allison Dukes will participate in a fireside chat at the BMO Financials Conference on November 9, 2026 at 1:15 p.m. ET.


A link to the live audio webcast will be available on the[Investor Relations section](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813281-1&h=1300533530&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.invesco.com%2Fcorporate%2Fen%2Finvestor-relations%2Fevents.html&a=Investor+Relations+section) of the corporate website. For those unable to listen to the live audio webcast, a replay will be available following the event.


**About Invesco Ltd.** Invesco Ltd. is one of the world's leading asset management firms serving clients in more than 120 countries. With US$2.5 trillion in assets under management as of Sept. 30, 2026, we deliver a comprehensive range of investment capabilities across public, private, active, and passive. Our collaborative mindset, breadth of solutions and global scale mean we're well positioned to help retail and institutional investors rethink challenges and find new possibilities for success. For more information, visit[www.invesco.com](http://www.invesco.com/) .
